source.title: Irish News, 18 May 1949, p. 3 ("Rural council nominations in the North")
source.publisher: Irish News (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)

note: Triennial election of the 21 electoral divisions of Coleraine rural district, one member each, polled on 2 June 1949. The Irish News prints the full nomination list of 18 May. Twenty members were returned unopposed; Aghadowey was contested between Matthew Workman and W. J. Anderson, but no result for that division was found, so it is not listed here. Returned unopposed.
